title: Chapter 674 - 674 Wedding; Blessing!
content:
Chapter 674 - 674 Wedding; Blessing!

Chapter 674 - 674 Wedding; Blessing!

674 Wedding; Blessing!

Everyone, including the people in Forbidden Area No. 2, the people in the Xia Alliance, and even the people from all over the world… All of them looked up at the sky and started discussing.

“What’s that?”

“Is this a 3D projection?”

“Congratulations on becoming an immortal! Someone is about to become an immortal? Are there really immortals in this world?”

“A thousand years ago, this scene also appeared!”

“Heavens!”

…

At this time, the white fog of Forbidden Area No. 2 had completely disappeared into Xia Xue’s body.

Suddenly, Xia Xue looked at Lin Fan with a completely different expression.

Gentle as water, hot as fire!

She could not help but walk forward and say in a coquettish voice, “Lin Fan!”

Almost at the same time, Xia Bing also walked over and said, “Lin Fan!”

When Lin Fan heard these two voices, he knew that Xia Xue had recovered her memories from a thousand years ago.

However, he still could not help but ask, “Xia Xue, how did you lose your memory before?”

Xia Xue whispered, “A thousand years ago, after obtaining the power, we had a special ability to calculate. We knew that you would come back in almost 1,000 years, so we decided to seal everyone here.

“But I was worried that you wouldn’t see us and would go somewhere else in search of us.

“Therefore, after nearly a thousand years, I forcefully woke up from the seal. I was afraid that it would affect the seal, so I used a special ability to ensure that the seal would operate normally at the cost of my memories and power.”

Lin Fan said, “Thank you.”

“It’s nothing.” Xia Xue and Xia Bing shook their heads gently, their faces full of happy smiles.

At this time, two pillars of light suddenly appeared from the golden door in the air and fell on Xia Xue and Xia Bing. A strong suction force appeared, as if it wanted to pull them in.

Lin Fan’s eyes shone with a golden light as he looked at the golden door and said, “We still have things to do. Let’s go in next time. Break!”

The pillar of light, the golden door, and the golden words… shattered and disappeared.

It was as if these things were just mirages.

Then, Lin Fan said, “Let’s go home.”

Instantly, Lin Fan, Lin Liqiang, Zhang Guidan, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin… all disappeared on the spot.

In the next moment, they appeared in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

That was right!

This was the Coiling Dragon Villa from a thousand years ago.

However, the location was the same, but the buildings and area were completely different.

The Coiling Dragon Villa had expanded by more than ten times. It even included the entire lake.

On top of the artistic foundation of the villas’ architecture, new technology was added.

The trees were lush, and the flowers were blooming.

This place… was simply a paradise.

After everyone came here, they all liked this place.

A month passed in the blink of an eye.

On this day, the entire Coiling Dragon Villa was surrounded by countless red roses. Bright red lanterns and banners could be seen everywhere. It was extremely festive.

Today, Lin Fan was going to marry his lovers forever.

Lin Xiaoyao looked at the tall man in a suit in front of her and praised, “Brother, you’re so handsome!”

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course!”

At this moment, a large group of women in white wedding dresses slowly walked over from afar.

They were Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, Ling Rou, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, Chen Xin, and Xu Jingrou… Everyone had a sweet smile on their faces.

No guests were invited to this wedding. It was carried out quietly under the witness of his parents.

Even so, everyone still felt happy.

A year passed in the blink of an eye.

Lin Fan reclaimed a piece of land in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

At this moment, he was planting soybeans with Hu Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, and the others. They were also watering carrots. They were extremely satisfied and relaxed.

“Jiaxin, your face is a little dirty,” Lin Fan said.

Hence, he reached out to wipe the dirt off Song Jiaxin’s face.

However, he had been planting vegetables all this time, and there was more soil on his hands than on Song Jiaxin’s face.

This wipe made Song Jiaxin’s face even dirtier.

“Jiaxin, your face looks very unique now,” Hu Tian chuckled.

Song Jiaxin quickly realized something and rebuked, “Ah! Lin Fan, you have to help me clean it up.”

“Alright, alright, alright,” Lin Fan said.

Hence, he wiped Song Jiaxin’s face with his hands.

With this wipe, Song Jiaxin’s face completely turned black.

Immediately, laughter rang out in the fields.

As the sun gradually set, everyone sat around to eat, relaxed and satisfied.

After dinner, they gathered to watch a movie.

A day passed in the blink of an eye.

The next day, Lin Fan woke up and stood in the courtyard to take a breath of fresh air.

At this moment, he suddenly raised his head and looked at the blue sky.

In the clear sky, a dazzling golden light appeared again.

The golden light continued to gather, gradually forming a huge golden door in the air.

Xia Xue and Xia Bing instantly appeared beside Lin Fan.

Lin Liqiang, Zhang Guidan, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, Ling Rou, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, and the others seemed to have sensed something different. They walked out and looked into the sky.

In fact, they were not the only ones who noticed this change.

Everyone in the world also noticed it and started discussing again.

“This golden door again.”

“What is it?”

“Can someone explain?”

….

Lin Fan smiled. “Grandpa, Grandma, Dad, Mom, Lil Yao, and everyone, don’t worry. I’ll go up and take a look. I should be back soon.”

“Don’t worry about us, Lil Fan,” Lin Tao said. “Just do what you should do.”

“Lil Fan, you must be careful!” Dai Weixue said.

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

Then, Lin Fan spent a few moments with Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, Ling Rou, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, Chen Xin, and Xu Jingrou…

Then, he looked at Xia Xue and Xia Bing.

The three of them nodded.

In the next moment, Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Xia Bing turned into three streaks of light, gold, blue, and red. They shot into the sky and entered the golden door.

After the three of them entered, the golden door gradually closed and disappeared.

Meanwhile, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, Ling Rou, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, and the others were still staring at the blue sky. They did not speak for a long time.

Their hearts were filled with prayers.

‘Lin Fan, you have to come back safely.’
